reader.requirement: At --std 85 an OPEN statement whose EXTEND phrase names a file whose FD carries a LINAGE clause (integer or data-name form, in any position of a multi-phrase OPEN, including a GLOBAL file opened in a contained program) must be refused; EXTEND on a file without LINAGE is accepted and extends it.
